name: Starter C: who do we go after?
engine: Beat one man, keep running at him, and turn the half wins against him into clean wins.
about: A man under pressure. A run or carry in midfield or their half that wins against one of their outfield men (a half win is enough) leaves him rattled until he wins a duel against you; your later runs and carries at him are +1 (Run at him). Once in each possession, a half win against a rattled man counts as a clean win: on a forward duel against him, or a tackle or press on him when they attack (Keep at him, captain Rodri); where it applies it replaces Run at him's +1. Guessing is on for both teams in every match.
decisions: Pick the man to go after and run at him: a half win is enough to rattle him.
Save the captain's call for the duel that matters: once a possession, a half win against the rattled man counts as a clean win.
On defence, a tackle or press on a rattled attacker gets the same call.
